title: Ashford Crossroads
short: A wind-scoured road crossing marked by red motes.
summary: Ashford Crossroads is quiet except for red motes drifting against the wind.
full: The road splits around an old mile marker blackened by heatless ash. Red motes gather in the ditch and move in patterns too regular to be weather.
entry: You arrive at Ashford Crossroads as the red motes brighten in the weeds.
sms: Ashford Crossroads. Red motes drift against the wind.
recap: You reached Ashford Crossroads and noticed the ember-sign.
success: You recognize a rune-like pattern in the motes.
failure: The motes scatter before you can read the pattern.
gm_notes: Use this scene to introduce the first clue.

variants.text: The ember-sign still glows faintly where you read its first pattern.
